model_role: Provincial hourly demand magnitude and chronology
publication_use: Calibrate or validate annual energy peak timing monthly profile and load-duration curve
known_limitations: Gross telemetered balancing-authority load is not regional demand and requires explicit timezone and daylight-saving treatment
retrieval_policy: Pin the study-year XLS and record URL retrieval time bytes and SHA-256

model_role: Hourly BC-Alberta and BC-US directional transfer limits
publication_use: Constrain and validate external-interface availability by direction
known_limitations: TTC is a path limit rather than realized flow and must not be treated as an internal line rating
retrieval_policy: Pin each study-year and direction XLS separately with hashes

publication_use: Validate modeled import-export chronology energy and peaks
known_limitations: The published hourly series may differ from the five-minute operational display and sign conventions require inspection
retrieval_policy: Pin the study-year XLS and document sign convention after parsing

publication_use: Contextual validation of balancing variability and reserve sensitivity
known_limitations: ACE does not directly identify reserve procurement or plant dispatch
retrieval_policy: Pin annual XLSX only for a declared balancing analysis

model_role: Station precipitation temperature snow level and surface-water observations
publication_use: Station mapping acquisition tests and recent-condition diagnostics
known_limitations: BC Hydro states these automated data are not quality-controlled and only up to four days are posted
retrieval_policy: Do not use as sole publication validation; map station IDs to historical WSC records where possible

temporal_coverage: near-real-time with links to historical WSC records
publication_use: Validate storage-state timing and operating-range compliance after elevation-volume conversion
known_limitations: Many BC Hydro pages expose only about 50 hours and level is not volume without a source-backed curve
retrieval_policy: Use pinned WSC historical series for hold-out validation and retain the BC Hydro station crosswalk

temporal_coverage: current forecasts and selected actual-flow context
model_role: Planned discharge and local flow context
publication_use: Check selected release timing and interpret operating conditions
known_limitations: Coverage is limited to selected facilities and published flows can change without notice
retrieval_policy: Archive only declared study events and label forecast versus actual

temporal_coverage: project-specific accepted plans and monitoring reports
model_role: Hydraulic routes release rules levels and operating logic
publication_use: Define or bound model constraints with page-level citations
known_limitations: Rules may be conditional historical superseded or require an operative order or owner-specific source
retrieval_policy: Use the Chapter 2 source registry manifest hashes and evidence decisions

model_role: Independent power project inventory resource type and contracted attributes
publication_use: Cross-check CODERS generator coverage status and resource class
known_limitations: PDF lists are snapshots and contractual energy is not necessarily hourly output or dependable capacity
retrieval_policy: Archive dated PDF releases and retain an asset-level reconciliation table

model_role: Bulk transmission corridors voltage classes and one-line topology
publication_use: Topology sanity check and schematic validation
known_limitations: Public PDFs are diagrams rather than downloadable GIS and detailed GIS requires ICIS membership
retrieval_policy: Archive dated PDFs and report topology differences rather than digitizing undocumented ratings

model_role: Power-flow line-rating path-rating and regional study evidence
publication_use: Support selected corridor ratings contingencies and benchmark cases
known_limitations: Availability and format vary by study and may not provide a complete current machine-readable network
retrieval_policy: Register each used study separately with page-level parameter evidence
